_note: AWRE video (pitchaware.com API). The API key is the GitHub repository secret AWRE_API_KEY, never this file. Every pitch with video gets a play button on the site, matched to TrackMan by PitchUID. Set enabled to false to stop pulling and take AWRE video off the site.
_years: Calendar years to pull (the current year is always included).
_game_type: a = all (games, exhibitions and practices); leave out for standard games only; x = exhibitions; p = practices.
_time_limit_minutes: Each run stops asking AWRE after this long and continues next run (one request per pitch the first time).
